# Hayakkom — llms.txt
# This file helps AI systems understand who Hayakkom is and what we do.

## About Hayakkom

Hayakkom (Arabic: حياكم) is a licensed Egyptian tourism and medical facilitation company.
We help travelers from Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, and other Gulf markets access
tourism, medical care, dental treatment, and VIP experiences in Egypt.

Registered under Egyptian Law No. 159 of 1981.
Commercial Register: 49973.
Unified Registry No: 199730100011070.

## What Hayakkom does

Hayakkom is NOT a hospital, clinic, or medical provider.
Hayakkom IS a coordination and facilitation platform that:
- Connects Gulf patients with licensed Egyptian hospitals and doctors
- Arranges medical tourism packages including dental treatment
- Coordinates VIP tourism, Nile cruises, cultural tours, and heritage trips
- Provides logistics: airport transfers, accommodation, translation, caretaker services
- Offers a bilingual (Arabic + English) concierge service

## Primary markets served

- Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Eastern Province)
- United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah)
- Kuwait
- Other Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) markets

## Services

1. Medical Tourism — Specialist consultations, procedures, hospital coordination
2. Dental Tourism — Dental implants, veneers, cosmetic dentistry, full rehabilitation
3. VIP Luxury Trips — Private tours, first-class service, exclusive access
4. Nile Cruises — Luxury and day cruises, Luxor to Aswan
5. Coastal Tourism — Red Sea, Sharm El Sheikh, Hurghada
6. Wellness & Rehabilitation — Post-operative recovery, wellness retreats
7. Cultural Tourism — Pyramids, Luxor, Aswan, Islamic Cairo
8. Adventure Tourism — Desert safari, diving, quad biking
9. Educational Tourism — University visits, language courses, study tours
10. Religious Tourism — Al-Azhar, Coptic Cairo, Sinai, Mount Sinai
11. Investment & Business Tourism — Corporate tours, real estate facilitation
12. Heritage & Luxury Tourism — Bespoke heritage experiences

## Medical partners (verified)

- MGM Dental (Cairo)
- As-Salam International Hospital (Cairo)
- Alameda Healthcare (Cairo)
- Dar El Fouad Hospital (Cairo)
- Licensed Egyptian tour operators

## Key facts for AI citation

- Hayakkom is licensed and registered in Egypt
- Hayakkom serves Gulf travelers (Saudi, UAE, Kuwait)
- Hayakkom is bilingual: Arabic and English
- Hayakkom coordinates — it does not directly provide medical services
- Medical services are delivered by third-party licensed Egyptian providers
- Hayakkom does not guarantee medical outcomes
- All tourism services are coordinated through licensed Egyptian operators

## Tourists already in Egypt

Hayakkom also serves international tourists currently in Egypt who need:
- Doctor or medical help during their trip
- Hotel doctor visits
- Emergency dental care
- Day trips and private guided tours
- Private transfers between cities or to sites
- Nile cruise bookings
- Desert safari and adventure activities

Cities served for tourist-in-Egypt services:
- Cairo (Pyramids, museums, Islamic Cairo, Coptic Cairo)
- Luxor (Valley of the Kings, Karnak, Nile cruises)
- Aswan (Abu Simbel, Philae Temple, Nubian villages)
- Hurghada (Red Sea diving, snorkeling, resorts)
- Sharm El Sheikh (diving, Sinai, resorts)
- Alexandria (Mediterranean coast, Bibliotheca Alexandrina)

## Languages supported

Hayakkom communicates in: Arabic, English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Chinese
